baby.001.en: Chinese Baby Name Generator by Birth Date | bazifor.me
baby.001.zh: 宝宝起名：按出生日期生成名字 / bazifor.me

baby.002.en: Build a Chinese baby name from the birth chart: 用神 elements, 五格 strokes, 三才, meaning, sound and gender fit scored, plus a printable certificate. Free to use.
baby.002.zh: 依据宝宝的八字起名：用神五行、五格笔画、三才、字义、读音和性别契合度逐项打分，并可打印起名证书。免费使用。

baby.009.en: ), and a name you build character by character, every rule cited.
baby.009.zh: ，以及逐字组合、每条规则都注明出处的名字。

baby.012.en: Get a scored Chinese name for your baby, built from the baby's own chart.
baby.012.zh: 依据宝宝自己的八字，生成带评分的中文名字。

baby.013.en: You need the surname character, sex, and the birth or due date and time.
baby.013.zh: 需要提供姓氏用字、性别，以及出生或预产日期和时间。

baby.014.en: You get useful elements, five grids, a ranked shortlist and a printable name card.
baby.014.zh: 你会得到用神五行、五格、按分数排序的候选名单，以及可打印的名字卡。

baby.015.en: Watercolour of a plum branch in blossom over a folded swaddling cloth with a small jade longevity lock
baby.015.zh: 水彩画：一枝盛开的梅花，下方是折起的襁褓布和一枚小小的长命玉锁

baby.017.en: Five details give the chart. Only the date is required.
baby.017.zh: 填写五项信息即可排盘，只有日期必填。

baby.019.en: Enter the Chinese character. Tan, Lim, Lee, Ng and Wong are spellings of a character.
baby.019.zh: 请输入汉字姓氏。Tan、Lim、Lee、Ng、Wong 这类写法只是汉字的拼写，并非汉字本身。

baby.024.en: An expected date gives a provisional chart. Run it again after the birth.
baby.024.zh: 预产期排出的是暂定命盘，宝宝出生后请重新计算。

baby.026.en: Clock time where the baby is born. Use 12:00 if you do not know it.
baby.026.zh: 出生地当地的钟表时间。不清楚就填 12:00。

baby.030.en: Pick the nearest city: its longitude and time zone set true solar time.
baby.030.zh: 请选最近的城市：系统按它的经度和时区换算真太阳时。

baby.033.en: Optional: score a name you already have in mind.
baby.033.zh: 选填：为你已经想好的名字打分。

baby.036.en: For a due date the chart is provisional, recalculate after birth with the exact time. The clock time is turned into true solar time for the birth city. Birth data is not stored by this page.
baby.036.zh: 若为预产期，命盘只是暂定，宝宝出生后请按准确时间重新计算。钟表时间会按出生城市换算为真太阳时。本页不会保存出生数据。

baby.038.en: Watercolour of a calligraphy brush resting beside an inkstone and a pine sprig
baby.038.zh: 水彩画：一支毛笔搁在砚台旁，边上有一枝松枝

baby.039.en: Example baby name card for the fictional name 王禄婷 with the seven-part score bars
baby.039.zh: 虚构名字王禄婷的示例名字卡，带七项评分条

baby.040.en: What you will get: the baby's useful elements, a ranked shortlist, and a name card you can print. The card shown is fictional.
baby.040.zh: 你将得到什么：宝宝的用神五行、按分数排序的候选名单，以及可打印的名字卡。图中的名字卡为虚构。

baby.042.en: The seven scoring parts, the grades and the sound check.
baby.042.zh: 七项评分、等级和读音检查。

baby.043.en: Every name you build is scored out of 100 in seven parts, and each part has a fixed weight:
baby.043.zh: 你组合出的每个名字都按 100 分制、分七项评分，每项权重固定：

baby.045.en: 30 (does each character carry an element your baby's BaZi chart needs:
baby.045.zh: 30（每个字是否带有宝宝八字所需的五行：

baby.055.en: 15 (whether the elements of the heaven, person and earth grids support each other),
baby.055.zh: 15（天格、人格、地格的五行是否相生），

baby.057.en: 10 (what the characters mean, in 16 meaning categories),
baby.057.zh: 10（字的含义，分为 16 个含义类别），

baby.059.zh: 5（声调、重复的音和不吉利的谐音），

baby.061.en: 5 (whether the characters suit a boy or a girl) and
baby.061.zh: 5（这些字更适合男孩还是女孩），以及

baby.063.en: 10 (how far the engine can trust the data behind the other parts). The weights add up to 100.
baby.063.zh: 10（引擎对其他各项所依据数据的可信程度）。各项权重相加为 100。

baby.064.en: The total maps to a grade:

baby.072.en: below 65. A strong sound hit caps the grade at needs a second look whatever the total.
baby.072.zh: 低于 65 分。读音一旦命中严重问题，无论总分多少，等级最高只到“待斟酌”。

baby.073.en: The sound layer checks two things. It looks for Mandarin sound-alikes, characters that sound like an unlucky or rude word, and it checks the English reading of the pinyin, since many Singapore and Malaysia families raise children who will be addressed in English at school and at work. Beside the score you also get the Five Grids with their auspicious (
baby.073.zh: 读音检查分两部分。一是找普通话里的谐音，即听起来像不吉利或粗俗词语的字；二是检查拼音的英文读法，因为不少新加坡和马来西亚的家庭，孩子在学校和工作中都会被人用英文称呼。除了分数，你还会看到五格的

baby.075.en: ) verdicts, the element of every character, its Kangxi (

baby.076.en: ) stroke count, a short reading of what the name suggests, and a shortlist of up to eight names you can compare.
baby.076.zh: 笔画数，一段简短的名字寓意解读，以及最多八个名字的候选名单，方便你比较。

baby.077.en: How Singapore and Malaysia names are handled
baby.077.zh: 新加坡和马来西亚的名字如何处理

baby.078.en: Romanised surnames, Kangxi strokes and true solar time.
baby.078.zh: 罗马字母拼写的姓氏、康熙笔画与真太阳时。

baby.079.en: Families in Singapore and Malaysia usually know their surname by a Hokkien, Teochew or Cantonese romanisation such as Tan, Lim, Lee, Ng or Wong, while the scoring needs the Chinese character. Enter the Chinese surname you choose in the surname box (for example
baby.079.zh: 新加坡和马来西亚的家庭，通常只知道姓氏的闽南话、潮州话或粤语拼写，如 Tan、Lim、Lee、Ng、Wong，而评分需要的是汉字。请在姓氏框里输入你选定的汉字姓氏（例如

baby.080.en: ) and the builder uses that character for the stroke count and the grids. The romanised spelling on a passport is a spelling of the character, not a different surname, so pick the character your family writes.
baby.080.zh: ），起名工具会用这个字计算笔画和五格。护照上的罗马字母拼写只是汉字的一种拼写，并不是另一个姓，所以请选你们家实际书写的那个字。

baby.083.zh: 笔画数，出自《康熙字典》，按每个字的繁体字形计数。繁体的

baby.084.en: has more strokes than the simplified
